profile.headline: Machine Learning Software Engineer at Guava

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Implemented PySpark and MapReduce tools for validating and debugging machine learning models.
- Ran experiments to find sufficient dataset sizes for good model generalization.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
-Operationalized new form of static code analysis using graph databases
-Discovered and reported 5 buffer overflow vulnerabilities in the OpenJPEG library
-Participated in red team activities such as hacking internal web servers

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
-Built NLU solutions for Intelligent Bots Cloud Service, Oracle's new enterprise chatbot system
-Implemented trie-based matching for entity extraction
-Prototyped algorithms to automatically generate responses based on past customer conversations
-Experimented with knowledge graphs to use in question-answering system

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
- Developed web applications for NetQuarry’s business clients
- Displayed client data by writing HTML web page templates
- Designed responsive and interactive pages with JQuery and other JavaScript APIs
- Wrote HTML email templates that show dynamic customer data and render correctly in all email clients
- Created SQL views from tables which are queried and displayed to the client or mapped to objects in code
- Programmed methods to generate custom HTML or JavaScript from client data that is injected into the web page’s source code

positions.title: Programming Intern
positions.description:
- Collaborated with professor and grad students on research project involving spatial databases
- Created Java program to organize and sort large files of geo-textual data from Yelp
- Input sorted files into MySQL database to be queried.

company.name: Cal State University, Fullerton, Computer Science Department

volunteerExperiences.description: Assisted hospital staff in the care and support of cancer patients and their families
Coached and refereed in a basketball league for young adults with special needs
